source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: The organizer publishes a timetable before the competition and events may not start more than thirty minutes early or run more than thirty minutes late; the last final of the evening must take the floor before 1:00 a.m., with a per-couple penalty after that.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must enforce or warn on the timetable window and the late-final limit.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-24. DanceFlow's schedule builder does not enforce the 30-minute window or the 1:00 a.m. rule. BLOCKER for an NDCA profile.
